scope: Synthetic fixed-model evaluation bootstrap; 2,000 training rows and 100,000 evaluation rows.
method: Separate fresh R processes on the same host. The optimized run calls performance_uncertainty(); the reference reranks both original fitted score vectors in each identical paired row resample.
timing_scope: Bootstrap scoring and interval construction for optimized; scoring for rerank. Both exclude fixture fitting. Peak process RSS includes fitting and evaluation setup.
limitations: Synthetic fixed-model evaluation uncertainty only. Single-host timings vary; this is not evidence of training scalability or competition performance.
numeric_oracles: The test suite independently compares paired bootstrap scores with explicit positive-negative pair enumeration, including ties and unequal whole groups.
